entries.title: Psalms 107:1
segments:
PSALM CVII. 
 
  The psalmist here observes God's providential care of the children of   men in general, and shews how he helps those that are in any distress,   in answer to their prayers.   He instances in banishment and dispersion, ver. 1-9.   Captivity and imprisonment, ver. 10-16.   Sickness, ver. 17-22.   Distress at sea, ver. 23-32.   The disposal of families and nations, ver. 33-13

entries.title: Psalms 107:4
segments: V. 4. No city-Or rather, no town inhabited, where they might refresh themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 107:6
segments: V. 6. The Lord-Heb. Unto Jehovah, to the true God. For the Heathens had, many of them, some knowledge of the true God.

entries.title: Psalms 107:10
segments: V. 10. Darkness-In dark prisons or dungeons.

entries.title: Psalms 107:12
segments: V. 12. Heart-The pride and obstinacy of their hearts. Fell-They fell into hopeless miseries.

entries.title: Psalms 107:32
segments: V. 32. Exalt him-In public assemblies, and before all persons, as they have opportunity.  Elders-The magistrates or rulers; let them not be ashamed nor afraid to speak of God's wonderful works, before the greatest of men.

entries.title: Psalms 107:33
segments: V. 33. Rivers-Those grounds which are well watered, and therefore fruitful.  And so the water-springs, here, and the standing water, ver.
are taken. Into-Into a dry ground, which is like a parched and barren wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 107:34
segments: V. 34. For-He doth not inflict these judgments without cause, but for the punishment of sin in some, and the prevention of it in others.

entries.title: Psalms 107:35
segments: V. 35. Water-Into a well-watered and fruitful land.

entries.title: Psalms 107:36
segments: V. 36. Hungry-Poor people who could not provide for themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 107:39
segments: V. 39. They-These men, who when they are exalted by God, grow insolent and secure.  Low-By God's just judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 107:40
segments: V. 40. Contempt-Renders them despicable.  Wander-Banishes them from their own courts and kingdoms, and forces them to flee into desolate wildernesses for shelter.
